spells.completeOriginalProcedure: KEEP Action,60feet,one magical effect locked in place so it CANNOT BE DISPELLED. NEW in place means protecting the continuing magical application,not spatial immobilization or permanent duration. Select one individually perceptible existing ongoing magical effect with an actual independent application/source identity and a genuine dispel interface,with a reachable actual recipient/anchor/effect portion within60feet and caster line of effect. No rank cap,save or owner consent is added; this can protect another source's beneficial or harmful effect,but cannot force that source to remain. A class engine/whole creature identity,completed instantaneous consequence,mundane matter or unselectable vague aura is not an eligible one-effect target. Actual source protections against targeting still apply. On successful resolution,NEW establish one nonconcentration Seal for up to24elapsed hours,ending earlier when the protected application ends. This explicitly supplies the missing lifetime rather than treating Instantaneous as frozen forever. While the Seal operates,ordinary dispelling cannot end the protected effect OR this protective Seal itself,including Greater Dispel and lower eligible dispels. The Seal cannot be trivially dispelled first to nullify the printed strong clause. A source explicitly overriding nondispellable protection retains only its real scope; no such bypass is invented here. Counterspell can stop the Seal during its own cast window,before protection exists; Seal does not retroactively protect a spell that has not yet resolved. Suppression is separate and can disable this Seal/protected effect where genuinely applicable without pausing either clock. While the Seal itself is suppressed its no-dispel benefit is unavailable; another actual dispel must still be independently able to resolve through any suppression/barriers and satisfy the protected effect's normal eligibility. This grants no casting inside antimagic exception. The protected effect keeps original owner,rank,DC,concentration,spatial motion,shape changes,charges,pulses,resource history,expiry,voluntary dismissal,dependent-body destruction and every non-dispel ending. No part is frozen or refilled; a minute effect still ends after its own minute even though the Seal could otherwise last a day. Target-local multi-recipient applications are separate: seal only the selected recipient application and its inseparable dependent components,not every remote recipient or original casting character. A genuinely indivisible field/wall can be one whole selected effect if a reachable portion is eligible. A spell-specific independent effect is not promoted into a larger parent to protect an entire catalog/class. Spell Seal cannot target itself or another Spell Seal,avoiding recursive protection records; its own protection is intrinsic. Multiple valid Seals may protect the same original application,with no cumulative duration addition or charge pooling; each keeps its own paid24-hour endpoint and benefit operates while at least one unsuppressed Seal remains. A new Seal cannot attach to an ended application,resurrect a replaced source,prevent a permitted controller dismissal or transfer source ownership. Ending a Seal does not itself end the otherwise still-live protected spell.
